fields.name: shipColor
fields.tooltip: Tints the ship icon — and its sprite, when one is assigned (white keeps the sprite's own colours).

fields.name: policeBlink
fields.tooltip: Off: the police icon holds one steady colour.

fields.name: policeRed
fields.tooltip: The police icon's colour (the first of the blink pair when blinking) and the patrol gap readout's warning colour.

fields.name: shipSpriteScale
fields.tooltip: Multiplies Ship Icon Size while a ship sprite is assigned.

fields.name: shipSpriteRotation
fields.tooltip: Z rotation of the ship icon while a ship sprite is assigned. Kept in sync with the Ship object's own rotation — edit either one.

fields.name: policeSpriteScale
fields.tooltip: Multiplies Police Icon Size while a police sprite is assigned.

fields.name: policeSpriteRotation
fields.tooltip: Z rotation of the police icon while a police sprite is assigned. Kept in sync with the Police object's own rotation — edit either one.

fields.name: chaseSpan
fields.tooltip: Pixels under the ship that stand for the full minimap range (GameSettings.minimapRangeMeters) — the patrol's zoomed gap scale. At track scale the gap would be a pixel or two.

fields.name: showTrackMap
fields.tooltip: Draw the top-down track map in the prefab's TrackMap rect: the whole track, the ship and the patrol on it, ramps, laser gates and the finish.

fields.name: showStrip
fields.tooltip: Also show the old vertical strip's bar and icons. Its distance labels stay either way.

fields.name: mapStartAtBottom
fields.tooltip: Turn the map so the start is at the bottom and the finish at the top. Off = world north up.

fields.name: mapPadding
fields.tooltip: Share of the map rect kept empty round the track, each side.

fields.name: mapSamples
fields.tooltip: Points the track line is drawn with (the whole track, evenly spaced).

fields.name: rampMarkerSprite
fields.tooltip: Optional marker sprites (empty = a plain square).

fields.name: checkpointMarkerColor
fields.tooltip: A time trial's checkpoints (TimeTrialPRD R5.4): the colour of one still ahead, and the alpha a passed one keeps.

fields.name: blinkInterval
fields.tooltip: Seconds between red/blue flips — same cadence as the patrol light bar.
